item.title: Core Keeper Greenhouse Guide — Crop Layout, Harvest Chance and Golden Crop Profit
item.description: A greenhouse is where Core Keeper shifts from “scavenge food” to “manufacture buffs.” This advanced guide covers the growth cycle, picking crops by ground type, stacking harvest chance for throughput, and laying out plots so watering never becomes a chore. The 10-minute growth cycle Once you water a seed, the timer runs on its own — you can leave and come back: Stage Time Watered seed → sprout 2 minutes Sprout → pre-harvest 4 minutes Pre-harvest → harvestable 4 minutes Every manual harvest grants gardening experience.
